entities.name: Arboretum de l'École du Breuil
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Arboretum de l'École du Breuil is a municipal arboretum located on the Route de la Ferme in the southeast corner of the Bois de Vincennes, Paris, France. It now forms part of the Jardin botanique de la Ville de Paris.
